metadata.layer: Layer 1B — Joint Visual x Distributional Allograph Collapse
metadata.distributional_features: PPMI + 32d TruncatedSVD over deduplicated strict oriented sequences (L/R/POS)

n_core_and_typology_verdict.rationale: Even under aggressive moderate visual+distributional collapse (vis>=0.62, dist>=0.55, comp<=5%) AND subtracting all 17 explicit PUA compounds, the 95.7%-token-coverage core retains 223–271 distinct graphemes (and 293–424 across all 713 raw ICIT signs). This exceeds pure syllabaries (~50–100 signs: Linear B ~87, Cypriot ~56) by >2x and matches functional core inventories of Bronze Age logo-syllabic scripts (Sumerian/Akkadian Cuneiform ~200–400 active core, Egyptian Hieroglyphs ~200–400 frequent signs, Maya ~250–350 active core).
